WITH dated_records AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATE(insert_date) as date_val
    FROM cities
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn'
      AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01'
      AND insert_date < '2021-08-01'
),
dates_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        date_val,
        LAG(date_val) OVER (ORDER BY date_val) as prev_date
    FROM dated_records
),
streak_markers AS (
    SELECT 
        date_val,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_date IS NULL OR date_val != prev_date + 1 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as is_new_streak
    FROM dates_with_prev
),
streak_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        date_val,
        SUM(is_new_streak) OVER (ORDER BY date_val) as streak_id
    FROM streak_markers
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT streak_id, COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM streak_ids
    GROUP BY streak_id
),
streak_info AS (
    SELECT 
        streak_id,
        streak_length,
        MIN(streak_length) OVER () as min_len,
        MAX(streak_length) OVER () as max_len
    FROM streak_lengths
),
all_records_with_streak AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        DATE(c.insert_date) as date_val,
        c.city_name,
        si.streak_id,
        sl.streak_length
    FROM cities c
    JOIN dated_records dr ON DATE(c.insert_date) = dr.date_val
    JOIN streak_ids si ON dr.date_val = si.date_val
    JOIN streak_lengths sl ON si.streak_id = sl.streak_id
    WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
      AND c.insert_date >= '2021-07-01'
      AND c.insert_date < '2021-08-01'
)

WITH date_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        insert_date,
        city_name
    FROM cities
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn'
      AND insert_date LIKE '2021-07-%'
),
date_only AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT insert_date
    FROM date_entries
),
with_offset AS (
    SELECT 
        insert_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) as rn,
        (CAST(insert_date AS DATE) - DATE('2021-07-01')) as days_offset
    FROM date_only
),
with_group AS (
    SELECT 
        insert_date,
        rn,
        days_offset,
        rn - days_offset as grp
    FROM with_offset
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        grp,
        COUNT(*) as streak_len,
        MIN(insert_date) as start_date,
        MAX(insert_date) as end_date
    FROM with_group
    GROUP BY grp
),
extreme_streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        grp,
        start_date,
        end_date
    FROM streaks
    WHERE streak_len IN (
        SELECT MIN(streak_len) FROM streaks
        UNION
        SELECT MAX(streak_len) FROM streaks
    )
